items.title: Jerry Bergonzi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 7, 2022
items.q: The transcript only shows the interviewer introducing himself as Monk Rowe. There is no evidence of a personal or professional relationship between the interviewee (Jerry Bergonzi) and Monk Rowe beyond the interviewer-interviewee dynamic.

ctx.x: Jerry was interviewed via Zoom on June 7, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College and I am at Hamilton College and Jerry Bergonzi, I assume you’re in Boston?
Yeah, well right outside of Boston in Medfield, Massachusetts, yup.
